name: Pasta Salad with Salmon, Artichokes, Pine Nuts & Basil Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a medium bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Drain and mince capers. Add to the bowl along with vinaigrette, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp capers
¼ cup French vinaigrette
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and artichoke hearts. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (340 g) jar roasted red bell peppers
1 (106 g) jar artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Drain salmon, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (213 g) can wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls; sprinkle with pine nuts. Enjoy!
